messages:
helen: New RFP from a regulated client — must be fully air-gapped for POC and production. They asked for physical media options, signed bundles, offline activation, proof of provenance, and a proposed upgrade cadence. Need a quick tech+commercial sketch to include in our response. @carl can you lead?

carl: Yep. Quick clarifiers: what media do they accept (SSD cartridge preferred), any single-file hard cap, and do they insist on vendor HSM or customer-supplied keys? Also confirm telemetry must be disabled by default.

mina: Customer prefers encrypted NVMe cartridges but will accept multiple signed USBs if smaller. Telemetry: must be off by default and opt-in only. They also requested chain-of-custody logging for every handoff.

pete: From ops: we recommend NVMe for >120GB, multipart archives for files >25GB. Our installer supports resume and integrity verification offline. We bundle a small verifier tool that checks signed manifest + SBOM before install.

pete: Example manifest snippet we include in deliveries:

```
manifest_v: "2026-01"
artifacts:
 - id: model-alpha-int8
   parts: ["a1","a2","a3"]
   sha256: cafebabe...
signed_by: redwood-release
provenance: provenance-alpha.signed.tar.gz
```

helen: Security questionnaire items flagged: FIPS algorithms for signing, ability to rotate certs without outbound connectivity, reproducible build logs for quantized models, and escrow options for signing keys.

carl: We offer three signing profiles: customer-provided key (preferred by many agencies), vendor HSM where customer holds key material, or vendor HSM with escrow (higher cost). All can use FIPS-approved ciphers. Note: on-prem HSM provisioning may add 4-8 weeks.

mina: Activation flows: CSR -> signed activation token -> offline import OR license file bound to HW fingerprint. Both work offline; we provide step-by-step import playbook and verification commands.

carl: Upgrade cadence question: client wants monthly security fixes, feature drops every 4 months. We can commit to security-only monthly deltas and feature bundles quarterly (every 34 months). Caveat: quantized delta builds can take 2472h for smaller models; for very large models expect up to 5 days. We'll list timelines in SOW.

pete: If client has no GPUs, we will supply quantized variants (int8/GPTQ). Producing quantized artifacts internally adds a prebuild step (~1218h) and we will deliver signed SBOM and build logs for provenance. If client insists on reproducible builds, include deterministic flags; some fuzz still possible on certain ops.

legal-bot: Reminder: include export-control clause for quantized weights and liability for physical media loss. Require buyer sign-off on chain-of-custody acceptance criteria.

helen: Buyer asked for a ballpark extra for offline packaging/signing + 3 days on-site validation. Please give a not-to-exceed band to include.

mina: Ballpark commercial: $35k$75k for offline packaging/signing & provenance work, depending on artifact count and HSM/escrow needs. On-site validation days quoted separately. Final quote after BOM.

pete: Proposed SOW acceptance checklist to include in proposal:
 - delivered media verifies against offline CA and signatures
 - SBOM and signed provenance provided
 - installer runs with no external DNS/NTP and exits non-destructively if checks fail
 - chunked install resumes after interruption and verifies checksums
 - cert rotation procedure validated in staging offline rig (no internet)
 - rollback to previous signed image validated within defined window (e.g., 6h)

carl: Action items: 1) Helen to request BOM + max file sizes + media preference (ETA: EOD). 2) Mina to draft the provenance + reproducible-build wording and quantization caveats. 3) Pete to validate chunked-resume limits and run a small NVMe delivery test on staging by Thurs. 4) Legal to draft escrow and export-control clauses.

helen: I'll send the buyer a short note with three signing options, our recommended NVMe+signed-manifest approach, and the price band. Will attach SOW checklist and ask for BOM. Keeping this thread as the source of truth.

carl: Sounds good. Ping me when BOM arrives and I'll run the quantization acceptance check with ML. :thumbsup:

pete: Staging offline rig maintenance window: 2026-04-06 02:00-05:00 UTC — perfect for tests.

mina: One more note: if buyer requests key escrow, include procurement lead time and an elevated security review.

helen: Thanks all. Closing for now, will update when BOM is in.
